responsibility: This machine description defines the DFA scheduler model for the 74K family, including 74kc and the 74kf variants with several FPU timing ratios. It describes ALU, address-generation, multiply/divide, and FPU resources together with extensive bypass rules and distinct reservations for the integer core and each floating-point configuration, making it the main scheduling model for MIPS32 74K-class tuning in GCC.
